claims.text: The Connaught is in the heart of Mayfair Village, on the corner of Carlos Place just off Berkeley Square.

findings.quote: Perfectly situated in the heart of Mayfair Village
The Connaught curves around the corner of Carlos Place just off Berkeley square

claims.text: The hotel is rooted in its Mount Street neighbourhood.

findings.quote: Deeply rooted in our Mount Street neighbourhood

claims.text: The hotel started life in 1815 as The Prince of Saxe-Coburg Hotel.

findings.quote: The Connaught started life in 1815 as the The Prince of Saxe-Coburg Hotel

claims.text: In 1917 it was renamed The Connaught, after Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn.

findings.quote: In 1917, it was renamed The Connaught, after Queen Victoria’s seventh child Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn.

claims.text: The reception hall has a gold-leaf-gilded mahogany staircase.

findings.quote: In the welcoming, flower-garlanded reception hall, lashings of dark woods are polished to perfection, marble gleams and a grandiosely solid, gold-leaf-gilded mahogany staircase twists heavenward.

claims.text: A water installation by Tadao Ando stands outside the front door.

findings.quote: a water installation by Tadao Ando outside the front door

claims.text: Rooms, designed by Guy Oliver, are split between the original building and the 2007 Connaught Wing.

findings.quote: the Connaught’s rooms (by Guy Oliver) are split between the original building and the 2007 Connaught Wing

claims.text: Bathrooms are in white marble with heated Toto seats.

findings.quote: the toto loo seats in the white-marble bathrooms exude a gentle heat

claims.text: The Coburg Suites have views over Carlos Place.

findings.quote: Coburg Suites are the newest. Off the broad corridors of the original building, they have views over Carlos Place

claims.text: The Apartment is a rooftop suite by David Collins Studio.

findings.quote: There are mega-suite options. David Collins Studio’s The Apartment is on the rooftop

claims.text: The Aman Spa is deep within the hotel, and its treatments include a Ku Nye full-body massage inspired by ancient Tibetan healing traditions.

findings.quote: Deep within The Connaught, the Aman Spa provides the perfect respite
Grounding might include a Ku Nye full-body massage inspired by ancient Tibetan healing traditions

claims.text: The Connaught Bar, designed by David Collins Studio, is known for its Martini trolley.

findings.quote: The Connaught Bar (by David Collins Studio) is one of the best drinking spots in London, with ultra-attentive and jolly service, their famous Martini trolley

claims.text: A private art collection of more than 3,000 pieces lines the staircase and public spaces.

findings.quote: A 3,000-plus-piece private collection distracts and bedazzles, lining the famed staircase and every other space besides.

claims.text: The subterranean levels hold a black granite pool and a meditative waterfall wall.

claims.text: Suites come with personal butlers and bespoke experiences.

findings.quote: with personal butlers and bespoke experiences setting a new standard for suite stays

claims.text: The King's Lodge suite was created by craftspeople and artisans from The Turquoise Mountain School in Kabul.

findings.quote: The King’s Lodge was created by craftspeople and artisans from The Turquoise Mountain School in Kabul, Afghanistan

claims.text: The Mews is a three-floor private townhouse with an outside terrace and a baby grand.

findings.quote: The Mews is a light-filled private townhouse on three floors by Blair Associates Architecture with an outside terrace and a baby grand.

claims.text: The pool and spa are on the hotel's subterranean levels.
